do.en: Check the assessment brief for permitted and restricted assistance.
do.zh: 查看作业说明中对辅助技术的具体限制。

do.en: Acknowledge assistance and cite external material.
do.zh: 说明使用的辅助并正确引用外部材料。

dont.en: Do not replace your own learning, understanding or skills with AI output.
dont.zh: 不要以AI输出取代自己的学习、理解或技能。

dont.en: Do not use paid services to prepare assessed coursework; Disability Services may recommend an exception.
dont.zh: 不要用收费服务准备考核作业；残障服务可推荐适用例外。

coursework:draft-action-1.text: Check the assessment brief for permitted and restricted assistance.
coursework:draft-action-1.scope: 2026/27 taught assessed coursework, including taught PGR components; research-degree non-taught work and examinations require their own rules.

evidence.quote: This policy applies to the assessed coursework of students on taught programmes (including the taught components of research postgraduate programmes) and is premised on the principle that the use of assistance will normally be permitted. If there are specific circumstances whereby demonstration of the learning outcomes associated with the assessment require restrictions on the use of assistance then these restrictions will be clearly set out in the assessment brief.
evidence.location: Purpose and Scope #3; SHA-256 identifies this retained UTF-8 excerpt, not raw HTML/PDF; physical page and original offsets unavailable.

evidence.quote: Students are permitted to use technologies to prepare work for assessment if restrictions are not specified within the assessment brief. Technologies may be used in a supportive capacity but will not replace a student’s own learning, understanding and skills. Students should be aware that the accuracy, reliability and security of technologies cannot be guaranteed.
